card.name: The word rechallenge after re
card.fires_on: The piece 'challenge' right after 're' in 'rechallenge', when a drug is given again and a reaction recurs. Weaker on pieces after 'co-' in words like co-administration and co-infected.

modes.label: Rechallenge
modes.description: 'challenge' completing 'rechallenge' when a reaction returns on re-exposure to a drug.
modes.example: Recurrence of liver transaminase elevations occurred with re<<challenge>> in some patients.

modes.label: Co- words
modes.description: The piece after 'co' in hyphenated words such as co-administration or co-infected.
modes.example: plasma digoxin concentrations were not altered by co<<-admin>>istration of miglitol 10
